programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

programme.title: The Equalizer 3
programme.desc: Finding himself at home in Southern Italy, former operative Robert McCall soon discovers his new friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall becomes their protector by taking on the mafia.

programme.title: The Substance
programme.desc: Fading actress Elisabeth Sparkle becomes distressed when her chauvinistic boss fires her from her aerobics show. She soon injects herself with a mysterious serum that promises a younger, better version of herself, but things go horribly wrong.

programme.title: The Pope's Exorcist
programme.desc: Father Gabriele Amorth, chief exorcist of the Vatican, uncovers a centuries-old conspiracy while investigating a young boy's terrifying possession.

programme.title: Boys Go to Jupiter
programme.desc: Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance.

programme.title: The Color Purple
programme.desc: Torn apart from her sister and her children, Celie faces many hardships, including an abusive husband. With support from a singer and her stepdaughter, she ultimately finds extraordinary strength in the unbreakable bonds of a new kind of sisterhood.

programme.title: Smoking Tigers
programme.desc: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

(Documentary)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Perilous Play

(Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Very Extreme Sports

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Young & the Reckless
programme.desc: S2E11 - When being young meant testing the limits of what our bodies could survive. From launching our bikes off homemade ramps and playing chicken in traffic, to using dangerous construction sites as our playground, childhood adventure was often intertwined with how far you were willing to go--and the consequences that came with it. Armed with cherry bombs, slingshots, and more confidence than caution, we pushed boundaries in ways that would make parents today shudder. (Documentary, Reality)

Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

However, this time, the fur flies when Hans and Billy kidnap the beloved pooch of a gangster (Woody Harrelson), and Marty uses the ensuing events as fodder for his screenplay. - Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell, Woody Harrelson, Abbie Cornish (Dark comedy)

The teens meet some locals: Tommy (Corey Feldman) and Trish (Kimberly Beck), as well as secretive hiker Rob (Erich Anderson). As the group of teenagers engages in drunken debauchery, their numbers begin to dwindle, and pieces of the past resurface. - Kimberly Beck, Peter Barton, Corey Feldman, Crispin Glover, Barbara Howard (Horror, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

When Billy finally proposes to his much-younger girlfriend, all four friends go to Las Vegas to celebrate the end of Billy's longtime bachelorhood and relive their glory days. However, the four quickly realize that the intervening decades have changed Sin City and tested their friendship in ways they had not imagined. - Michael Douglas, Robert De Niro, Morgan Freeman, Kevin Kline, Mary Steenburgen (Comedy)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James, Jon Bernthal, Jon Hamm (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. - Will Ferrell, Mark Wahlberg, Linda Cardellini, Thomas Haden Church, Scarlett Estevez (Comedy)

Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos. - Mark Wahlberg, Kurt Russell, Douglas M. programme.title: Last Vegas
programme.desc: Aging pals Billy (Michael Douglas), Paddy (Robert De Niro), Archie (Morgan Freeman) and Sam (Kevin Kline) have been best friends since childhood. When Billy finally proposes to his much-younger girlfriend, all four friends go to Las Vegas to celebrate the end of Billy's longtime bachelorhood and relive their glory days. However, the four quickly realize that the intervening decades have changed Sin City and tested their friendship in ways they had not imagined. - Michael Douglas, Robert De Niro, Morgan Freeman, Kevin Kline, Mary Steenburgen (Comedy)

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: A low-level Washington, D.C., public servant, Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), is thrust into the national spotlight when he's asked by Martin Geller (Dylan Baker), the head of the Democratic Party, to run for president after the party's presidential and vice-presidential nominees are killed in a plane crash. The odds are against Gilliam, mostly because he has a penchant for telling the truth about what is wrong with the country. Remarkably, his straight-talking style catches on with the public. - Chris Rock, Bernie Mac, Dylan Baker, Nick Searcy, Lynn Whitfield (Comedy)

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place. - Matthew McConaughey, Sarah Jessica Parker, Zooey Deschanel, Justin Bartha, Bradley Cooper (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. - Matthew Broderick, Reese Witherspoon, Chris Klein, Jessica Campbell, Mark Harelik (Comedy, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia. - Joseph Fiennes, Jude Law, Rachel Weisz, Bob Hoskins, Ed Harris (War, Drama, Action, Historical drama, Romance)

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Jet Li, Terry Crews, Randy Couture (Action, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Jet Li, Dolph Lundgren, Chuck Norris (Action, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: After a former associate makes it his mission to end the Expendables, Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone) assembles a team of younger, tech-savvy recruits to help take down their enemy.

programme.title: Expend4bles
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: A police inspector (Nick Nolte) suspects a law student (Ewan McGregor) or his friend (Josh Brolin) of serial killings and eerie events at the city morgue.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: In the last city on Earth, underground rebels dispatch their top assassin (Charlize Theron) to kill a government leader.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: An account of the 101st Airborne Division's 10-day struggle to secure a strategic mountainside in South Vietnam.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: An ex-cop doing prison time chases a virtual-reality killer from the program onto the Los Angeles streets.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond is a New York City money launderer who wakes up with no memory and millions of dollars in stolen cash and drugs. He must soon scour the streets in search of answers while trying to dodge a crew of violent and crooked cops.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it. - Tom Cruise, Miles Teller, Jennifer Connelly, Jon Hamm, Glen Powell (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael is on his daily commute home, which quickly becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a mysterious stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a deadly plan is unfolding, and he is unwittingly caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train. - Liam Neeson, Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson, Jonathan Banks, Sam Neill (Thriller, Mystery, Action)

programme.title: The Machinist
programme.desc: Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian). - Christian Bale, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, John Sharian, Michael Ironside (Thriller)

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: A serial killer (Elijah Wood) removes his victims' scalps and attaches them to the vintage mannequins he restores in his late mother's shop. - Elijah Wood, Nora Arnezeder, Megan Duffy, Jan Broberg, Genevieve Alexandra (Horror)

programme.title: The Warrior
programme.desc: Set in feudal India, the film is a sweeping mythical adventure story about a lone warrior who renounces his violent role as the longtime enforcer to a local lord -- only to be murderously pursued into the Himalayan mountains by the lord, who refuses to accept his departure. - Irfan Khan, Mandakini Goswami, Sunita Sharma, Noor Mani, Damayanti Marfatia (Adventure, Drama)

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael is on his daily commute home, which quickly becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a mysterious stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a deadly plan is unfolding, and he is unwittingly caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train. - Liam Neeson, Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson, Jonathan Banks, Sam Neill (Thriller, Mystery, Action)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them. - Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan, Rosario Dawson, Michael Chiklis, Anthony Mackie (Family, Action, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed. - Danny Glover, Willem Dafoe, Brad Johnson, Rosanna Arquette, Tom Sizemore (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas. - Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen, Oliver Reed, Derek Jacobi (Historical drama, Adventure, Action, Drama)

programme.title: Star Trek: Section 31
programme.desc: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets. - Michelle Yeoh, Omari Hardwick, Kacey Rohl, Sam Richardson, Sven Ruygrok (Science fiction, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. - Zach Galifianakis, Owen Wilson, Kristen Wiig, Ross Kimball, Devin Ratray (Comedy, Action)

programme.title: Good Morning, Vietnam
programme.desc: Radio funny man Adrian Cronauer (Robin Williams) is sent to Vietnam to bring a little comedy back into the lives of the soldiers. After setting up shop, Cronauer delights the G.I.s but shocks his superior officer, Sergeant Major Dickerson (J.T. Walsh), with his irreverent take on the war. While Dickerson attempts to censor Cronauer's broadcasts, Cronauer pursues a relationship with a Vietnamese girl named Trinh (Chintara Sukapatana), who shows him the horrors of war first-hand. - Robin Williams, Forest Whitaker, Tung Thanh Tran, Chintara Sukapatana, Bruno Kirby (Comedy, War, Drama)

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa. - Andrew Garfield, Richard Pyros, Jacob Warner, Milo Gibson, Sam Worthington (War, Historical drama, Biography, Docudrama)

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas. - Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen, Oliver Reed, Derek Jacobi (Historical drama, Adventure, Action, Drama)

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is. - Matthew Gray Gubler, AnnaLynne McCord, Alisha Boe, Sheila Vand, Sam Eidson (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: Kindred
programme.desc: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are. - Deanna Jarvis, Derick Agyemang, Kylee Evans, Jonathan Goad, Ish Morris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. - Mel Gibson, Madeleine Stowe, Greg Kinnear, Sam Elliott, Chris Klein (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Resurgence: DeMarcus Cousins
programme.desc: A documentary following DeMarcus Cousins while he recovers from an injury that has been a career death sentence for some NBA players; featuring exclusive interviews with teammates, coaches and NBA insiders. - DeMarcus Cousins, John Calipari, Mike Malone, Steve Kerr, Isaiah Thomas (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh. - Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: A notorious crime boss forces two legendary car thieves to steal a vehicle to win back their freedom. Joined by two beautiful women, the team has one week to pull off the daring heist or risk losing everything, including their lives. - Scott Eastwood, Freddie Thorp, Ana de Armas, Gaia Weiss, Simon Abkarian (Action, Thriller)

Blu is thought to be the last of his kind, but when word comes that Jewel, a lone female, lives in Rio de Janeiro, Blu and Linda go to meet her. Animal smugglers kidnap Blu and Jewel, but the pair soon escape and begin a perilous adventure back to freedom -- and Linda. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Musical)

When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

The resourceful pair finds an abandoned hotel, and with the help of Bruce's mechanical skills, turn it into a pooch paradise for Friday and a number of strays. But when the inevitable barking makes neighbors suspicious, Andi and Bruce must find a way to hide their canine haven from prying eyes. - Emma Roberts, Jake T. Austin, Lisa Kudrow, Kevin Dillon, Don Cheadle (Children, Comedy, Drama, Adventure)

The boys, Artie and Harry, are trying to cope with their own emotional baggage, so the three decide to throw convention to the wind and live by the words "just say yes." When things go wrong, Joe must find a way to behave more like a parent while maintaining the joys of a more-carefree life. - Clive Owen, Emma Booth, Laura Fraser, George MacKay, Nicholas McAnulty (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Middle School: The Worst Years of My Life

This doesn't sit well with Rafe. While the adults come up with a dodgy scheme, the friends try a more practical approach to the problem with the help of Helga (Francesca Marie Smith). The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark, but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

But, soon after they embark on the mission, Tommy and his friends lose their way in the woods and get into trouble with a pack of wild monkeys who have escaped from the circus. The kids begin to think that maybe things weren't so bad at home after all. - E.G. Daily (Animated, Children, Adventure)

When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

Suddenly, even her best friends are against her, and Harriet resolves to take revenge. - Michelle Trachtenberg, Rosie O'Donnell, Vanessa Lee Chester, Gregory Smith, J. programme.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown - Inferno
programme.desc: S1E1 - On April 26, 1986, a massive explosion rips through a reactor during a safety test at a power plant in Ukraine, triggering the worst nuclear accident in history; within 24 hours, a lethal radioactive cloud starts to circle the globe. (Documentary)

programme.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown - Cover Up
programme.desc: S1E2 - The day after the incident, helicopter crews brave deadly radioactive smoke to extinguish the fire raging in the reactor core; as 50,000 locals evacuate, Soviet authorities try to conceal the scale and human cost of the accident. (Documentary)

programme.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown - Sacrifice
programme.desc: S1E3 - In the weeks following the meltdown, workers battle lethal radiation to clear debris and construct a protective tomb around the destroyed reactor; amid speculation, Soviet scientists reveal what they can about the cause of the catastrophe. (Documentary)

programme.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown - Fallout
programme.desc: S1E4 - As the USSR collapses, an investigation uncovers the cause of the accident and scale of the Soviet cover up; Chernobyl's toxic legacy persists as the nuclear exclusion zone becomes a war zone, raising fears of another disaster. (Documentary)

programme.title: The Eighties - The Reagan Revolution
programme.desc: S1E2 - Exploring the two-term presidency of Ronald Reagan; highlighting his triumphs and controversies. - H.W. Brands, Chris Connelly, Gil Troy, James Baker III, Douglas Brinkley (Documentary, History)

programme.title: The Eighties - Tear Down This Wall
programme.desc: S1E3 - A historic chain of events that puts an end to the decades-long Cold War, culminating in the eradication of the Berlin Wall. - H.W. Brands, Chris Connelly, Gil Troy, James Baker III, Douglas Brinkley (Documentary, History, Politics)

programme.title: The Eighties - The Tech Boom
programme.desc: S1E7 - The technology boom that brought us the innovations that define our life today, the personal computer and the Internet. - H.W. Brands, Chris Connelly, Gil Troy, James Baker III, Douglas Brinkley (Documentary, History, Technology)

programme.title: The Eighties - Greed Is Good
programme.desc: S1E4 - Greed and excess ran wild with Wall Street corruption, junk bonds, bailouts and Reaganomics. (Documentary, History)

programme.title: Tomorrow Transformed - Clean Energy
programme.desc: Clean energy projects are transforming businesses and lives in Malaysia, South Africa and Australia; in Malaysia, we discovered how used cooking oil is being repurposed to power planes, while in South Africa, a start-up uses hydrogen to solve the country's energy problems, and Australia scientists are using the power of the sun to transform the energy sector. (News)

programme.title: Connecting Africa - Patrice Motsepe
programme.desc: S1E83 - South African billionaire Patrice Motsepe is investing heavily in the continent's industrial future. From exploring the potential of mining precious metals to utilizing the latest renewable energy technology and leveraging digital banking, we explore how Mr. Motsepe's business ventures are pushing the continent forward. (Documentary)

programme.title: Inside Africa - Africa's New Storytellers
programme.desc: Across Africa, creators are challenging old narratives and reshaping how the continent is seen. From youth-led media in Kenya to animation on the global stage and artists supported by Africa No Filter in Nigeria, meet the storytellers putting African voices, experiences and imagination at the center of the story. - Isha Sesay (Travel)

programme.title: African Voices - Olori Atuwatse III
programme.desc: Larry Madowo travels to Nigeria's historic Warri Kingdom to meet Queen Consort Olori Atuwatse III. Discover how she's redefining modern royalty by championing education, empowering women, and inspiring the next generation, proving that leadership is about service, not status. (Documentary, Biography)

programme.title: African Voices - Isha Sesay
programme.desc: Former CNN anchor Isha Sesay speaks about her decision to leave the network after more than 13 years; she discusses the influence of her late mother, her decision to have a baby on her own and her role as CEO of Areya Media. (Documentary, Biography)

programme.title: Marketplace Asia - China's Humanoid Ambition; Cathay Cargo (New)
programme.desc: S1E57 - Mike Valerio explores China's race to deploy humanoid robots in factories as the country looks to reshape the future of manufacturing; Kristie Lu Stout goes behind the scenes with Cathay Pacific to see how horses are transported across continents from Liège to Hong Kong. (News, Bus./financial)

programme.title: Marketplace Africa - The Future of Medical Training; Stella Okoli
programme.desc: Across East Africa, a growing trend of businesses looking to develop a new way to teach the next generation of surgeons is happening; with both IRCAD Africa, a training center focused primarily on minimally invasive surgeries and Proximie, a digital platform designed for connecting surgeons across the world for training purposes, a model is emerging for a way to educate a broader group of students and for ideas to flow between regions across the globe. (Bus./financial, News)

programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened. - Christina Ricci, Colleen Camp, Lew Temple, Nick Vallelonga, Santino Barnard (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Strange Wilderness
programme.desc: The hosts (Steve Zahn, Allen Covert) of a TV wildlife program hope to save their show from cancellation by finding the legendary Bigfoot.

programme.title: Vacation
programme.desc: Following in his father's footsteps, Rusty Griswold takes his wife and two sons on a cross-country road trip to America's favorite fun park, Walley World.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: Three high-school seniors (Drake Bell, Andrew Caldwell, Kevin Covais) spend a wild weekend with members of Fairmont University's rowdiest fraternity.

programme.title: Personal Shopper
programme.desc: A young American in Paris works as a personal shopper for a celebrity. She seems to have the ability to communicate with spirits, like her recently deceased twin brother. Soon, she starts to receive ambiguous messages from an unknown source.

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: James Bond's (Daniel Craig) hunt for those responsible for Vesper Lynd's death leads him to a ruthless businessman (Mathieu Amalric) who is plotting to seize control of a valuable resource.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: A square British exchange student (Maxwell Caulfield) turns hip motorcyclist to woo a cool girl (Michelle Pfeiffer) in his 1961 high school.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: A talented high school basketball player's (Taylor John Smith) dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his hard-drinking father's (Michael Shannon) compulsive gambling.

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: After experiencing what they think are break-ins, a family realizes that the events unfolding before them are more sinister than they seem.

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman meets his new baseball teammates, an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partiers.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

programme.title: Good Mourning
programme.desc: A movie star must choose between pursuing his one true love or landing a life-changing role in a film.

programme.title: Buddy Games: Spring Awakening
programme.desc: Faced with their biggest challenge yet, the gang sets out to honor a lost pal, only to find themselves in the middle of where it all began -- spring break. They soon learn their old school ways of partying can hardly compete with today's generation. - Dan Bakkedahl, Kevin Dillon, Josh Duhamel, James Roday Rodriguez, Nick Swardson (Comedy)

programme.title: Good Boys
programme.desc: Invited to his first kissing party, 12-year-old Max asks his best friends Lucas and Thor for some much-needed help on how to pucker up. When they hit a dead end, Max decides to use his father's drone to spy on the teenage girls next door. When the boys lose the drone, they skip school and hatch a plan to retrieve it before Max's dad can figure out what happened. - Jacob Tremblay, Keith L. Williams, Brady Noon, Molly Gordon, Lil Rel Howery (Comedy)

programme.title: Men, Women & Children
programme.desc: Like many Americans, average suburbanite Don Truby and his 15-year-old son use the Internet for information, communication and viewing pornography. Don's son Chris also maintains sexually explicit conversations with classmate Hannah, an aspiring actress whose mother posts pictures of her daughter on a modeling Website. In sharp contrast, overprotective mom Patricia Beltmeyer does everything in her power to protect her daughter from the digital age. - Rosemarie DeWitt, Jennifer Garner, Judy Greer, Dean Norris, Adam Sandler (Drama)

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman meets his new baseball teammates, an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partiers. - Will Brittain, Zoey Deutch, Ryan Guzman, Tyler Hoechlin, Blake Jenner (Comedy)

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another. - Fionn O'Shea, Robert Aramayo, Erin Kellyman, Louis Hofmann, Jodi Balfour (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home. - Jason Segel, Dakota Johnson, Casey Affleck, Isabella Kai Rice, Violet McGraw (Drama)

programme.title: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
programme.desc: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius tells the simple story of a 10-year-old boy and his robot dog - battling evil, rescuing his parents, saving the Earth - and returning home in time for dinner. Jimmy's always inventing gadgets to make his life in Retroville more interesting. A boy genius with real kid emotions, Jimmy sometimes fantasizes about life on his own. But when the parents of Jimmy's hometown are kidnapped by invading aliens, he quickly discovers that things aren't so great when they're gone. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: The owner of a factory that produces flavor extracts, Joel Reynold (Jason Bateman) seems to have it all, but really doesn't. What's missing is sexual attention from his wife, Suzie (Kristen Wiig). Joel hatches a convoluted plan to get Suzie to cheat on him, thereby clearing the way for Joel to have an affair with Cindy (Mila Kunis), an employee. Simmons (Comedy)

Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)
